The class of every ExperimentSubset object

Source: R/allClasses.R
ExperimentSubset-class.Rd

A virtual class that the five Subset* classes extend: SubsetSummarizedExperiment, SubsetRangedSummarizedExperiment, SubsetSingleCellExperiment, SubsetTreeSummarizedExperiment and SubsetSpatialExperiment. Use is(x, "ExperimentSubset") to test whether x is an ExperimentSubset object, whichever class it extends. A SubsetSpatialExperiment, for example, is not a SubsetSingleCellExperiment, though it extends SingleCellExperiment.

Details

The class is virtual, so there are no objects of the class itself. Create an ExperimentSubset object with ExperimentSubset().

Examples

# simulate counts for 10 genes in 20 spots
set.seed(1)
values <- rpois(200, lambda = 5)
counts <- matrix(values, nrow = 10)
rownames(counts) <- paste0("gene", 1:10)
colnames(counts) <- paste0("spot", 1:20)

# make a SpatialExperiment from the counts
spe <- SpatialExperiment(assays = list(counts = counts))

# convert it to an ExperimentSubset object
es <- ExperimentSubset(spe)

# es is an ExperimentSubset: TRUE
is(es, "ExperimentSubset")
#> [1] TRUE

# but not a SubsetSingleCellExperiment, though it extends
# SingleCellExperiment: FALSE
is(es, "SubsetSingleCellExperiment")
#> [1] FALSE

# the SpatialExperiment it was made from is not an ExperimentSubset: FALSE
is(spe, "ExperimentSubset")
#> [1] FALSE
